scope: Supplied anonymized input, target, semanticChecks, output and error only. No other evaluation artifacts or model identities used for judgments.
limitations: Assistant linguistic judgment, not native-speaker or expert validation. Source corpus and checks are not human gold. Register varies by region and context. Equivalent clock notation accepted when PM is preserved; bare 6:30 loses the explicit evening distinction. Unavailable output is excluded from semantic quality judgments.
